items.summary: Update the backend’s active Admin verification credentials so that Admin Dashboard access requires successful completion of the three-step sequence using the newly provided Code #1, Code #2, and Code #3 (in that exact order), and ensure the new Master Override Code is the only master override credential accepted for master-override verification and code rotation.

Ensure the new Code #1/#2/#3 and the new Master Override Code are treated as secrets: do not embed their plaintext values anywhere in the frontend bundle, and do not log them to browser console, backend logs, or error messages; store/validate them server-side in a way suitable for rotation (e.g., hashed/derived representation rather than plaintext).

Keep the Admin Dashboard closed off: all /admin routes and all admin-only backend mutations must remain protected by the admin verification session (three-step verification), and must not become publicly accessible.

Add upgrade-safe initialization/migration so that existing deployments are updated to use the newly provided Code #1/#2/#3 and Master Override Code values (without requiring the old codes to be known), while preserving existing per-principal permanent lockout state.

Update the frontend Admin verification UX copy (gate screen and verification-code management page) as needed so it accurately reflects the system behavior: three steps in order (Step 1/3, 2/3, 3/3) and Master Override Code for code rotation, without referencing any retired/previous admin authentication system.
